Counting without child_count builds and discards every child widget (allocating each one), and it runs on every SliverList::delegate / grid construction via delegate_builder. Cache the probed count so it runs once per delegate: add a count: Cell<Option<usize>> field to SliverChildBuilderDelegate and return the cached value if present, otherwise probe and store it.
